description_en: Queries the port forwarding rules created for an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防实例下已创建的端口转发规则
name: DescribePort

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to query.

You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The Forwarding Protocol type to query. Valid values:

tcp: TCP protocol.
udp: UDP protocol
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的转发协议类型。取值：

tcp：表示TCP协议。
udp：表示UDP协议
parameters.name: frontend_protocol

parameters.help_en: The forward port to query. Valid values: 0 to 65535
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的转发端口。取值范围：0~65535
parameters.name: frontend_port

parameters.help_en: The page number to return in a paged query. For example, set this parameter to 1 to return the first page of results
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时返回的页码。例如，查询第一页的返回结果，则设置1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of records on each page in a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页包含的记录数量
parameters.name: page_size

NetworkRules.description_en: The list of port forwarding rules
NetworkRules.description_zh: 端口转发规则配置列表

FrontendProtocol.description_en:
The Forwarding Protocol type. Valid values:
tcp: TCP protocol.
udp: UDP protocol
FrontendProtocol.description_zh:
转发协议类型。取值：
tcp：表示TCP协议。
udp：表示UDP协议

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to which the forwarding rule belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 转发规则所属的DDoS高防实例的ID

IsAutoCreate.description_en:
Indicates whether the rule is automatically generated by Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium. Valid values:
true: The rule is automatically generated by Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium.
false: The rule is manually created
IsAutoCreate.description_zh:
该规则是否由DDoS高防自动生成。取值：
true：表示由DDoS高防自动生成。
false：表示由您手动创建

RealServers.description_en: The list of origin server IP addresses

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The number of port forwarding rules returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 返回的端口转发规则的数量
